items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-09-08
items.q: Jim never laid down, Jim cut on that. That's what made the band sound good too... I'd give him the rhythm, alright.

ctx.x: And he wanted to get some old music together, you see. And he wanted some jazz. So Santiago told him, saying, I wanted the most little jazzy fella we knowed around here. And he started around there, way around Budapetite time, you see. It was right there, you see. And my brother wouldn't play without me, you know. He didn't even want to play on a lot of other drums, you see. Because he knew what I was going to do. And you see, all he had to do was look at me and I knew what he wanted, you see.
